## What changed?

Describe the visitor-facing change and its source/organizer approval.

## Checks

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_site.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_site.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_site.py --root _site`
- [ ] Desktop and mobile preview checked, including keyboard navigation
- [ ] Dates, status, organizer details, links, and downloads reviewed
- [ ] No private proposal drafts, participant data, credentials, or unapproved personal details added
- [ ] Relevant items in `docs/LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md` reviewed

## Publication impact

After Pages is enabled and `PAGES_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true`, merging to `main` publishes this change automatically. Record anything that needs approval before merge.
